title: Protein Gel Sample Preparation
author: Cleo B.
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7p9hmr6

steps.title: Prepare Tricine Sample Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the tricine sample buffer by adding beta-mercaptoethanol to a final concentration of 2%.

steps.title: Dilute Sample with Tricine Buffer
steps.instruction: Dilute the sample using a 1:1 ratio (1 part sample with 1 part sample buffer).

steps.title: Prepare Laemmli Sample Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the 4x Laemmli sample buffer by adding 100 µL of beta-mercaptoethanol per 900 µL of buffer.

steps.title: Dilute Sample with Laemmli Buffer
steps.instruction: Dilute the sample using a 3:1 ratio (3 parts sample with 1 part sample buffer).

steps.title: Process and Load Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the samples for loading onto the gel.

substeps.instruction: Spin samples down for approximately 10 seconds.
